output.summary: Approve isolated experiment runner for lab loop candidates.

approvedRows.question: DTR-isolated-experiment-runner
approvedRows.currentState: Lab candidates can be scored with visible and sealed gates, but there is no isolated runner that applies candidate loop files in a temp worktree with score-only sealed feedback.
approvedRows.desiredState: Add npm run lab:experiment to create an isolated temp worktree, apply candidate files only to lab/<loop>/loop.ts, run visible/pipeline/objective checks, optionally run sealed holdout or judge calibration, and redact sealed command output.
approvedRows.rationale: Autonomous or optimizer-facing experiments need safe isolation and no access to private holdout details.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users can safely run candidate experiments and receive score-only feedback.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get a controlled command for future optimizer loops and promotion evidence.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Small bounded lab tooling addition with direct tests and no production runtime behavior change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Experiment runner creates an isolated temp worktree and applies candidate files only to lab/<loop>/loop.ts.
Experiment runner runs visible gate, pipeline gate, objective, and optional sealed judge/holdout commands with aggregate score summaries.
Sealed evaluator command output is redacted so private case details are not exposed.

approvedRows.recommendationRationale: The change is lab-only runner tooling with tests and no production runtime dependency.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: The user approved implementing the isolated experiment runner next.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Completes the lab safety loop needed for candidate evaluation.
agentAssessment.rationale: Isolation and score-only sealed summaries reduce overfitting and accidental production mutation.

approvedRows.currentPain: Candidates must be tested directly in the working tree or by manual command composition.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: Operators can evaluate candidate loop files without mutating production source or exposing sealed case details.
approvedRows.successSignal: Tests prove candidate file allowlist enforcement, isolated visible gate execution, candidate file application, and sealed output redaction.
nonGoals: Do not mutate src production graphs.
Do not expose sealed case details.

acceptanceEvidenceItems.summary: lab:experiment copies a bounded repo subset to a temp worktree, symlinks node_modules, rejects candidate dirs with unexpected files, and applies only allowed loop.ts files.
Experiment runner executes visible gate, pipeline gate, objective, optional judge calibration, and reports aggregate metric summaries.
Experiment runner redacts sealed objective and judge calibration command tails while exposing aggregate score summaries.

implementationAssessment.maintainability: Experiment runner is isolated in lab/runner/experiment-runner.ts and locked out of candidate edit scope.
implementationAssessment.simplicity: The runner uses a temp copy plus node_modules symlink and avoids worktree/git complexity.
implementationAssessment.projectStyle: Matches lab holdout and calibration policy by keeping sealed details off the feedback channel.
implementationAssessment.errorHandling: Unexpected candidate files, command failures, sealed false passes, and judge false passes become report blockers.
implementationAssessment.uncertaintyResolution: Typecheck, targeted tests, lab tests, experiment command, full tests, build, lab reports, audit, and diff hygiene passed.
implementationAssessment.rationale: This gives optimizers a safe score-only candidate loop without mutating production source.

sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.security: No network or model dependency added; judge calibration runs only if requested/configured.
sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.privacy: Sealed evaluator command output is redacted and private bundle paths are not required.
sensitiveSurfaceAssessment.rationale: The change is lab-only experiment tooling, docs, and tests.
